clean_description: Set in 1970s New York, 'Crook Manifesto' follows Ray Carney, a furniture store owner and former fence, as he navigates the chaotic streets of Harlem. As crime rises and the city faces bankruptcy, Carney's attempts to lead a straight life are complicated by his past connections and the violent antics of his partner, Pepper. The novel explores themes of family and survival against the backdrop of a city in turmoil, blending dark humor with a vivid portrayal of the era.
